cleared.evidence: backend/auth/tokens.py:34 now rejects an expired token before the refresh.

findings.title: Partial capture ignored in refund
findings.issue: The refund total uses the full order amount and ignores partial captures.
findings.trigger: Capture 40 of 100, then refund: the refund shows 100.

findings.title: Split rounding drops one cent
findings.issue: Splitting an amount in three parts drops one cent through rounding.
findings.fix: Give the rest to the last part.

findings.title: Order reference logged in clear text
findings.issue: The order reference is written to the log in clear text.

findings.title: Query in a loop on the bulk path
findings.issue: The bulk path runs the loop for up to 400 lines, one query each.
findings.evidence: backend/orders/bulk.py:20 calls the loop with up to 400 lines.

findings.title: Session id kept at login
findings.issue: The session id does not change at login.
findings.trigger: An attacker sets a session id, the user logs in, the attacker keeps access.
findings.evidence: backend/auth/middleware.py:12 skips the rotation for API clients, so the login route keeps the old id.

findings.title: CSV cells start with formula characters
findings.issue: The CSV export writes cell values that start with an equals sign without escaping.
findings.trigger: A customer name starts with =, and a spreadsheet runs it.

findings.title: Duplicate helper
findings.issue: The new module copies the date helper from the billing module.

findings.title: Debug flag read from query
findings.issue: The view reads a debug flag from the query string.
